searchText: Hi all, I just realized we have an edge case which is not described by the EIPs. What if a code section has size 0? I believe this should be invalid EOF.

Hi all, I just realized we have an edge case which is not described by the EIPs. 

What if a code section has size 0? I believe this should be invalid EOF.
